lines.text: In the third year of the drought, the LORD tells Elijah to go to Ahab, and he will send rain.
Obadiah, in charge of Ahab's palace, fears the LORD and hid a hundred prophets in caves, fifty men per cave.
Ahab and Obadiah search the land for grass for the horses and mules together, and Elijah meets Obadiah.

wrong_details.true: They divided the land, and Ahab went one way by himself and Obadiah the other way by himself

lines.text: Elijah tells Obadiah to announce him to Ahab, but Obadiah fears Ahab will put him to death.
Elijah promises to meet Ahab tomorrow, then tells him to gather Israel and the prophets of Baal at Mount Sinai.
